# Contributor Code of Conduct

We welcome contributors of every experience level, gender, gender identity and
expression, sexual orientation, disability, appearance, body size, race,
ethnicity, age, religion, and nationality.

## Expected behavior

Be respectful, consider different experiences, give constructive feedback, and
focus disagreements on ideas rather than people. Help make participation
welcoming for people contributing code, design, documentation, questions, and
community work.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, sexualized language or imagery, personal attacks, trolling,
and publishing another person's private information without permission are
unacceptable. Other conduct that undermines safe, respectful participation may
also require moderation.

## Scope

This policy applies in project spaces and when someone represents the project
or its community publicly. It applies to maintainers as well as contributors.

## Reporting

Report concerns privately to [admin@spokanetech.org](mailto:admin@spokanetech.org).
Include enough context for a review, without disclosing unnecessary personal
information. Do not use a public issue for sensitive conduct reports.

If a report concerns a maintainer, ask for review by another maintainer. If that
is not possible, the project may need to seek an independent reviewer; this
policy does not promise an independent reporting office.

## Enforcement

Maintainers review reports in context and may remove content, issue a warning,
restrict participation temporarily, or exclude a participant. The response should
be proportionate to the conduct and its impact. A person involved in a complaint
should not decide its outcome. Requests for reconsideration can be sent to the
same contact address and should be reviewed by an uninvolved maintainer when
available.

Report information will be shared only as needed for investigation, enforcement,
or applicable obligations. Absolute confidentiality cannot be guaranteed.
